single_draft_main.description: Paper Table 1 analogue: single draft, draft length 4, temperature 1, vocabulary 6; three content regimes (peaked/medium/flat target entropy, analogues of GSM8K/HumanEval/CNN-DM) x two draft/target pairings (analogues of different target sizes).
single_draft_main.notes: Scaled setup: synthetic target/draft pairs with vocabularies of 3-6 tokens and exact enumeration of all drafts replace Qwen2.5 0.5B/14B-72B on GSM8K/HumanEval/CNN-DM; numbers are not on the paper's scale, so the paper's values are kept under _paper_reported only. Lossless single-draft verification has a known optimum (block verification, Sun et al. 2024); the paper's HSD (Algorithm 2) is algebraically identical to it, so the reference sits at this experiment's bound: methods can tie it, not beat it.

block_efficiency.description: Exact expected number of tokens emitted per target-model step (accepted draft tokens + the one token every step emits), averaged over the experiment's held-out contexts. Computed by the evaluator by enumerating every draft (tuple) at every context, so it carries no Monte-Carlo noise. A method that is not exactly lossless (completion total variation > 1e-9 at any context, on any experiment), breaks the protocol, crashes or times out scores the failure sentinel 0.0 here (every valid decoder scores >= 1).

_paper_reported.setting: Qwen2.5-0.5B draft, gamma=10, temperature 1, block efficiency (tokens/step); targets 14B/32B/72B

single_draft_main._reference_note: results are the exact held-out (test-slice) values of the exported reference (hsd) and baseline programs; hsd gain over tokenwise = 6.10%. Exact evaluation: rerunning in a different problem order changes them by < 2e-14.

multi_draft.description: Paper Table 2 analogue: several i.i.d. drafts per target step (2 drafts of length 4 over 3 tokens, 2 drafts of length 3 over 4 tokens, 3 drafts of length 3 over 3 tokens), temperature 1, three content regimes x two draft/target pairings. The experiment where the paper's own procedure is not optimal.
multi_draft.notes: Scaled setup: synthetic target/draft pairs with vocabularies of 3-6 tokens and exact enumeration of all drafts replace Qwen2.5 0.5B/14B-72B on GSM8K/HumanEval/CNN-DM; numbers are not on the paper's scale, so the paper's values are kept under _paper_reported only. The paper uses 11 drafts of length 10; this gym uses 2-3 drafts so that every draft tuple can be enumerated exactly. The paper reports no multi-draft blockwise verifier; the blockwise baseline here verifies only the first draft.
